text:
Recommended protocol: freeze the trained model, users, targets, candidate IDs/order and tie-breaking across original and shuffled evaluations. Shuffle only nonpadding positions in the actual model input; prefix shuffles preserve its final item. Sample five independent uniform position permutations with replacement per condition using recorded per-user seeds. Repeated item IDs remain separate occurrences; distinct position permutations can produce identical histories. Retain identity and unchanged-history draws, including unavoidable ones for short/constant histories; report their frequency and distinct histories observed. Rejecting these draws changes the estimand to sensitivity conditional on a changed history. These are perturbation experiments, not automatically valid null-hypothesis permutation tests; formal tests require exchangeability assumptions ([Hemerik–Goeman](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6405018/)).

For each user, compute original HR@10 minus the mean over five shuffles, separately for full and prefix conditions; compute their paired contrast within user. Bootstrap users within each category, retaining each user’s original result and all ten shuffled results together; never treat shuffles as independent users. Report percentile 95% intervals from a reproducible bootstrap. This follows the cluster-bootstrap principle of resampling independent units with their repeated observations ([Stata](https://www.stata.com/support/faqs/statistics/bootstrap-with-panel-data/)). Such intervals include finite-shuffle noise already present in user means; they do not isolate pure user uncertainty.

Separately estimate conditional permutation Monte Carlo variance: for category c, independent draws give V_c = Σ_u s²_uc/(5n_c²), using within-user shuffle variance. For contrasts, include covariance when conditions share randomness. Five draws yield noisy estimates; additional independent shuffle batches improve assessment. Report each category and the equal-weight macro mean, Δ = ¼Σ_c Δ_c; recompute that mean in every stratified bootstrap replicate. Under independent category randomization, macro Monte Carlo variance is Σ_c V_c/16. These estimates condition on the fitted models and fixed candidates.
